title: 30-year Treasury yield tops 5.33%, new 19-year high on inflation, spending concerns
summary: The 30-year Treasury yield reached approximately 5.322%, approaching its highest level since 2002, driven by inflation and government spending concerns. This marks a significant increase in long-term borrowing costs that could impact mortgages and other long-term debt instruments.
content: Tuesday saw yields on U.S. 30-year Treasury yields add over 1 basis point to trade at around 5.322%, hovering just below its highest level since 2002.

zh.title: 30年期国债收益率升至5.33%，创19年新高，受通胀和支出担忧推动
zh.summary: 30年期国债收益率达到约5.322%，接近自2002年以来的最高水平，受通胀和政府支出担忧推动。这标志着长期借贷成本大幅上升，可能影响抵押贷款和其他长期债务工具。

title: Home Depot revenue rises even as customers turn away from bigger projects
summary: Home Depot exceeded Wall Street expectations in Q2 as customers shifted toward smaller home improvement projects instead of major renovations. The shift reflects changing consumer spending patterns in the home improvement sector.
content: The home improvement retailer beat Wall Street estimates in its second quarter as its customers continued to take up smaller projects.

zh.title: 家得宝收入上升，尽管顾客转向较小型项目
zh.summary: 家得宝在第二季度超过华尔街预期，因为客户转向小型家装项目而非大规模翻新。这一转变反映了家装行业消费支出模式的变化。

title: Stocks keep shrugging off rising Treasury yields. Here’s the level that could finally trigger a selloff.
summary: Despite climbing 10-year Treasury yields, stock markets have remained resilient, but Strategas predicts yields will need to rise significantly higher before triggering a market correction. The analysis suggests the current yield level hasn't reached the threshold that would cause a meaningful equity selloff.
content: The yield on the 10-year Treasury yield continues to climb, but our call of the day from Strategas says that ascent will be much higher before stocks start to hurt.

zh.title: 股票继续不受上升国债收益率影响，这是可能触发抛售的水平
zh.summary: 尽管10年期国债收益率攀升，股票市场仍表现稳健，但Strategas预测收益率需要大幅上升才能触发市场回调。分析表明当前收益率水平还未达到可能引发股票大幅抛售的临界点。

title: My son does not work, yet pays $500 for Affordable Care Act health insurance. Is that fair?
summary: The article highlights concerns about Affordable Care Act Marketplace subsidies being available to individuals with significant wealth but minimal taxable income, raising questions about subsidy targeting. This illustrates a gap in ACA subsidy rules that critics argue should be addressed.
content: “I see people who have a lot of money but little or no taxable income who still qualify for ACA Marketplace subsidies.”

zh.title: 我的儿子没有工作，却要支付500美元的平价医疗法案健康保险。这公平吗?
zh.summary: 这篇文章强调了人们对《平价医疗法案》市场补贴的担忧，这些补贴对拥有大量财富但应税收入最少的个人可用，引发了关于补贴针对性的问题。这说明了《平价医疗法案》补贴规则中存在的漏洞，批评人士认为应该解决这个问题。

title: Popular language app is on the cusp of a turnaround. Buy the stock now, D.A. Davidson says
summary: Duolingo is showing signs of recovery by winning back users and developing new monetization strategies for its language-learning platform, according to D.A. Davidson's bullish outlook. The analyst expects the company to capitalize on user engagement to drive revenue growth.
content: Duolingo is showing signs of winning back users and finding new paths to monetize its language-learning platform, D.A. Davidson says.

zh.title: 热门语言应用即将迎来转机。D.A. Davidson表示现在就购买这只股票
zh.summary: 根据D.A. Davidson的看涨前景，Duolingo通过赢回用户并为其语言学习平台开发新的盈利策略而显示出复苏迹象。分析师预计该公司将通过充分利用用户参与度来推动收入增长。

title: 'Worrisome': AI is driving a looming market correction, central bank economists warn
summary: European Central Bank economists warn that AI-driven market valuations may face a significant correction, even if current valuations are justified by AI's transformative potential. Historical market patterns suggest that fairly-valued stocks can experience sharp declines.
content: History suggests valuations will tumble even if they are a fair reflection of the transformative power of AI, according to a European Central Bank analysis.

zh.title: 令人担忧：中央银行经济学家警告人工智能正在推动即将到来的市场调整
zh.summary: 欧洲中央银行经济学家警告，人工智能驱动的市场估值可能面临重大调整，即使当前估值是由人工智能的变革潜力所证实的。历史市场模式表明，公允价值的股票可能会经历大幅下跌。

title: Fund managers have rarely been this bullish about stocks, says a Bank of America survey
summary: A Bank of America survey shows fund managers at unusually high bullish levels despite concerns about interest rates, global slowdown, geopolitical instability, and AI capital expenditure. The survey indicates investor confidence remains strong despite multiple potential headwinds.
content: Higher interest rates, a global slowdown, political instability and AI capex are just four things about which investors aren’t especially troubled in late summer.

zh.title: 美国银行调查：基金经理对股票看涨情绪罕见高涨
zh.summary: 美国银行调查显示，尽管存在对利率上升、全球经济放缓、地缘政治不稳定和人工智能资本支出的担忧，基金经理的看涨水平仍处于异常高位。该调查表明，尽管面临多个潜在风险，投资者信心仍然强劲。

title: Prediction markets entrant Novig posts more than $125 million in trading volume during its first week
summary: Novig, a new entrant in the prediction markets space, achieved over $125 million in notional trading volume during its first week of operation. The strong initial volume suggests growing interest in prediction market platforms.
content: The newly launched Novig has reported over $125 million in notional trading volume.

zh.title: 预测市场新秀Novig首周交易量超1.25亿美元
zh.summary: 预测市场领域的新进入者Novig在首周运营中实现了超过1.25亿美元的名义交易量。强劲的初期成交量表明人们对预测市场平台的兴趣不断增长。

title: Sea Ray parent Brunswick bets on AI navigation and new revenue streams to help stalling boat sales
summary: Brunswick Corporation is investing in AI navigation technology and exploring new revenue streams to revitalize its struggling boat sales, with CEO David Foulkes noting that premium boats remain strong while value-oriented models lag. The strategy aims to address broader challenges in the boating industry.
content: Brunswick Corp. CEO David Foulkes told CNBC premium boat sales are staying afloat, while value options are lagging.

zh.title: 赛瑞亚母公司布伦瑞克押注AI导航和新收入流以振兴船舶销售
zh.summary: 布伦瑞克公司正在投资人工智能导航技术，并探索新的收入流来振兴其困难的船舶销售。首席执行官大卫·福尔克斯指出，高端船舶市场保持强势，而中低端船型表现滞后。该战略旨在应对船舶行业面临的更广泛挑战。

title: Nvidia's AI moat is shifting from chips to capital
summary: While Nvidia maintains dominant market share in AI chips, the company is increasingly leveraging capital investments as a competitive advantage as competition in the chip market intensifies. This shift reflects Nvidia's strategy to expand beyond hardware into broader AI infrastructure.
content: Nvidia still has dominant market share in AI chips, but with competition picking up steam, the company is taking greater advantage of another key asset.

zh.title: 英伟达的AI护城河正从芯片转向资本
zh.summary: 虽然英伟达在AI芯片市场上保持着主导地位，但随着芯片市场竞争加剧，该公司越来越多地利用资本投资作为竞争优势。这一转变反映了英伟达扩展到硬件之外、进入更广泛AI基础设施的战略。

title: Russia says its economy is strong. It just fired a top economist who warned otherwise
summary: Russia dismissed a top economist after he presented a report warning the country cannot sustain prolonged economic warfare with Ukraine. The move highlights tensions between official optimism about the economy and expert assessments of economic vulnerabilities.
content: Andrei Klepach was reportedly fired from his role after presenting a report warning that Russia could not win a prolonged war of attrition with Ukraine.

zh.title: 俄罗斯称其经济强劲。它刚刚解雇了一位持相反意见的顶级经济学家
zh.summary: 俄罗斯在一位顶级经济学家提交了警告该国无法承受与乌克兰长期经济战争的报告后将其解雇。此举突显了官方对经济乐观态度与专家对经济脆弱性评估之间的紧张关系。

title: The TI-84 has ruled math classes for decades. Can cheaper calculators gain ground?
summary: Despite SAT and AP tests now offering free digital graphing options, Texas Instruments' TI-84 calculator continues to dominate classrooms because school districts struggle to transition away from the established standard. The article examines barriers to replacing entrenched hardware in educational settings.
content: SAT and AP tests now offer free digital graphing options for students, but it’s harder than it seems for school districts to look beyond Texas Instruments.

zh.title: TI-84计算器统治数学课堂数十年。廉价计算器能否获得市场份额？
zh.summary: 尽管SAT和AP测试现在提供免费数字制图工具，德州仪器的TI-84计算器仍继续在教室中占据主导地位，因为学区难以从既定标准转换。该文章探讨了在教育环境中替换根深蒂固硬件的障碍。

title: Home Depot reaffirms guidance amid 'frozen housing market conditions'
summary: Home Depot beat Wall Street expectations in its fiscal Q2 while maintaining its full-year guidance despite describing housing market conditions as frozen. The company's solid performance stands out against a challenging residential real estate environment.
content: Home Depot reported second fiscal quarter results that beat Wall Street expectations on the top and bottom lines.

zh.title: Home Depot在"冻结的房屋市场条件"下重申指导目标
zh.summary: Home Depot在财政第二季度超过华尔街预期，同时维持全年指导目标，尽管描述房屋市场条件冻结。公司的稳健表现在充满挑战的住宅房地产环境中脱颖而出。

title: Stocks making the biggest moves premarket: Home Depot, Tesla, Fabrinet, Duolingo & more
summary: Multiple stocks including Home Depot, Tesla, Fabrinet, and Duolingo are experiencing significant price movements in premarket trading. The article covers earnings reports and other catalysts affecting these companies.
content: These are some of the stocks posting the largest moves in early trading.

zh.title: 盘前价格波动最大的股票：Home Depot、Tesla、Fabrinet、Duolingo及其他
zh.summary: 包括Home Depot、Tesla、Fabrinet和Duolingo在内的多只股票在盘前交易中经历显著价格波动。该文章涵盖影响这些公司的收益报告和其他催化因素。

title: ‘I’m running out of time’: I sold my $300,000 rental property at a $75,000 loss. Should I buy another one to avoid taxes?
summary: A property owner sold a rental property at a significant loss and is considering purchasing another property to offset taxes, raising questions about proper tax-loss harvesting strategy. The situation highlights the importance of consulting with tax professionals before making real estate decisions.
content: “My CPA hasn’t gotten back to me.”

zh.title: "我时间不多了"：我以$75,000的损失出售了价值$300,000的出租物业。我应该购买另一个来避税吗？
zh.summary: 物业所有者以巨大损失出售了出租物业，并考虑购买另一处物业来抵消税款，引发了关于正确的税损收获策略的问题。这种情况强调了在做出房地产决定之前咨询税务专业人士的重要性。

title: Job vacancies at five-year low as smaller firms scale back recruitment
summary: UK job vacancies have fallen to a five-year low as small firms reduce hiring due to labour and operating cost pressures, according to the country's statistics body. This indicates cooling demand for workers and potential economic headwinds for the job market.
content: Small firms cite labour and operating costs as reasons for scaling back hiring, the UK's statistics body says.

zh.title: 小企业缩减招聘，英国职位空缺降至五年新低
zh.summary: 根据英国统计机构数据，由于劳动力和运营成本压力，小企业减少招聘，英国职位空缺已降至五年新低。这表明劳动力需求在降温，可能预示着就业市场面临经济逆风。

title: The 30-year Treasury yield just hit a 19-year high. Three things could drive it even higher
summary: The 30-year U.S. Treasury yield has reached its highest level in 19 years, signaling potential shifts in borrowing costs and inflation expectations. Some strategists believe further increases are possible, which could impact mortgage rates and investment returns.
content: The yield on the 30-year U.S. Treasury has surged to its highest level in 19 years, and some strategists see scope for the move to go further.

zh.title: 30年期美债收益率创19年新高，三大因素可能推高
zh.summary: 美国30年期国债收益率已达19年最高水平，预示借贷成本和通胀预期的潜在变化。一些策略师认为收益率可能进一步上升，这将影响抵押贷款利率和投资回报。

title: South Korea must brace for ‘worst-case scenario,’ President Lee says, as Trump cuts military drills
summary: South Korea's President Lee warns of worst-case scenarios as the U.S. reduces annual defensive military exercises with South Korea following Trump's policy shift. This reduction raises concerns about the peninsula's security posture amid ongoing tensions with North Korea.
content: The annual exercises, are defensive and not intended to attack North Korea or raise tensions on the peninsula, Lee said.

zh.title: 特朗普削减军事演习，韩国总统李在明呼吁为最坏情况做好准备
zh.summary: 随着特朗普政策调整，美国减少了与韩国的年度防御性军事演习。韩国总统李在明对最坏情况发出警告，这一削减在朝鲜半岛持续紧张之际引发了对其安全态势的担忧。

title: Homeowner feared energy grant scheme was a scam
summary: A homeowner was cautious about an energy grant scheme, initially fearing it might be fraudulent. The program has proven successful in Cambridgeshire councils, which are now requesting additional government funding to expand it.
content: Councils in Cambridgeshire have asked the government for more money after the success of the scheme.

zh.title: 房主担心能源补助计划是诈骗
zh.summary: 一位房主对一项能源补助计划持谨慎态度，最初担心这可能是欺诈。该计划在剑桥郡的议会中已证明成功，这些议会现在要求政府提供额外资金以扩大该计划。

title: 'It was either feed my animals or feed myself'
summary: Pet food banks report declining donations during the summer months, as households struggle with rising costs and difficult financial choices. The decline reflects broader economic pressures affecting both pet owners and food assistance programs.
content: Pet food banks says donations of food have dipped over the summer.

zh.title: "要么喂饱我的动物，要么喂饱自己"
zh.summary: 宠物粮食银行报告称夏季期间捐款减少，因为家庭苦于成本上升和困难的财务选择。这种下降反映了影响宠物主人和食物援助项目的更广泛的经济压力。

title: Ship attacked in Hormuz Strait as U.S.-Iran ceasefire expiry risks prolonged conflict
summary: A ship was attacked in the Hormuz Strait, sustaining engine room damage and a crew casualty, as tensions rise following the expiration of a U.S.-Iran ceasefire. The incident highlights escalating risks to maritime commerce in a critical global shipping corridor.
content: The attack caused damage to the engine room and resulted in a crew casualty, UKMTO said, adding that the remaining crew were being assisted by the Omani Coast Guard.

zh.title: 船舶在霍尔木兹海峡遭攻击，美伊停火期满面临长期冲突风险
zh.summary: 一艘船在霍尔木兹海峡遭到攻击，机舱受损并有船员伤亡。随着美伊停火期满，紧张局势升级。该事件突显了全球关键航运走廊中海事商业面临的升级风险。

title: Commerzbank CEO Bettina Orlopp on leading a turnaround under takeover pressure
summary: Commerzbank CEO Bettina Orlopp discusses the bank's turnaround strategy amid UniCredit's takeover push, which has accelerated the company's strategic initiatives. Her leadership approach balances operational transformation with pressure from a potential acquisition.
content: CEO Bettina Orlopp discusses Commerzbank’s turnaround, her leadership philosophy and how UniCredit’s takeover push accelerated its strategy work.

zh.title: Commerzbank首席执行官贝蒂娜·奥洛普在收购压力下领导转型
zh.summary: Commerzbank首席执行官贝蒂娜·奥洛普讨论了该银行在UniCredit收购压力下的转型战略，这加速了公司的战略举措。她的领导方法在运营转型与潜在收购压力之间保持平衡。

title: Options investors are betting on this trend in gold prices, Susquehanna says
summary: Gold markets are experiencing muted volatility with strengthening upside potential and renewed investor inflows, according to analysis from Susquehanna. Options traders are positioning themselves to capitalize on this trend shift.
content: Gold is seeing muted volatility, firmer upside skew and renewed inflows.

zh.title: 期权投资者押注黄金价格趋势，Susquehanna公司表示
zh.summary: 根据Susquehanna的分析，黄金市场正经历温和波动，上升潜力增强，投资者流入增加。期权交易者正在布局以利用这一趋势转变。

title: Bitcoin is overdue for moves of 30% or more, Fundstrat says
summary: Fundstrat analysts predict Bitcoin could be positioned for a significant move of approximately 30% or more over the next two months. This forecast suggests potential major price volatility ahead for the cryptocurrency.
content: Bitcoin could be poised for a move of around 30% or more over the next two months, said Fundstrat.

zh.title: 比特币即将面临30%或更高的涨幅，Fundstrat表示
zh.summary: Fundstrat分析师预测比特币在接下来两个月内可能出现约30%或更高的重大涨幅。这一预测表明加密货币前方可能会经历重大的价格波动。

title: Disabled people in England to get 24-hour free bus travel
summary: England will provide 24-hour free bus travel for disabled people starting in April, a change welcomed by campaign groups. This expansion aims to improve mobility and independence for disabled individuals.
content: The change, which has been welcomed by campaign groups, will come into effect in England from April.

zh.title: 英格兰残疾人将获得24小时免费公交车出行
zh.summary: 英格兰将从4月开始为残疾人提供24小时免费公交车出行，这一举措得到了倡导团体的欢迎。这一扩展旨在改善残疾人的出行便利性和独立性。

title: US-Canada trade talks 'intense' as new tariff deadline looms
summary: US-Canada trade negotiations intensify as negotiators race to meet Trump's tariff deadline. Canada must convince the public to accept any concessions made during the talks.
content: Mark Carney will need to sell Canadians on any concessions made to the US as negotiators scramble to reach a deal to avoid Trump’s latest tariffs.

zh.title: 随着新关税截止日期逼近，美加贸易谈判"激烈"进行
zh.summary: 随着谈判代表争取赶上特朗普的关税截止日期，美加贸易谈判加剧。加拿大必须说服公众接受在谈判中做出的任何妥协。
